name: Polycab India Ltd
about: Polycab manufactures wires and cables and fast-moving electrical goods (fans, lights, switches) and runs an EPC business.

chunks.title: Q3 FY26 earnings call transcript
chunks.text: We remain confident of the Project Spring targets: we aim to grow revenue at 1.5 times the industry and deliver wires & cables EBITDA margin of 11 to 13 percent through FY30.

chunks.title: Q3 FY26 earnings call transcript
chunks.text: FMEG will reach EBITDA breakeven in the next two to three quarters as fans and lights scale; switchgear continues to lead.

chunks.title: Q3 FY26 earnings call transcript
chunks.text: Analysts pressed on the working capital build: inventory went up because we pre-bought copper ahead of the price increase, it will normalise by March.

chunks.title: Q4 FY26 earnings call transcript
chunks.text: Export revenue was soft this quarter because of the US tariff overhang; we expect exports to be 6 to 8 percent of revenue over time.

chunks.title: Q4 FY26 earnings call transcript
chunks.text: Cable demand from power transmission, data centres and real estate remains very strong; we are running at high utilisation.

chunks.title: Q1 FY27 earnings call transcript
chunks.text: On working capital, receivable days increased due to EPC project billing; this is temporary and linked to the BharatNet project.

chunks.title: Q2 FY27 earnings call transcript
chunks.text: Working capital days rose to 71 versus 58 last year; we expect it to come back toward 60 days by the end of the year as EPC collections come in.

chunks.title: Q2 FY27 earnings call transcript
chunks.text: Wires & cables EBITDA margin for the quarter was 14.1 percent; we continue to guide 11 to 13 percent as a sustainable band.

analysis.verdict: Growth is beating every promise (revenue +45% YoY), but working capital is quietly eating the cash: CFO was 0.71× PAT in FY26.

ledger.delivered: Revenue +46%, +19%, +39%, +45% YoY over the next four quarters

ledger.promise: Wires & cables EBITDA margin in an 11–13% band
ledger.delivered: Group OPM 13.4–14.9% in the last four quarters; segment above the band twice

ledger.promise: FMEG at EBITDA breakeven within 2–3 quarters
ledger.delivered: Turned positive (0.8%) two quarters later, per Q1 FY27 call

ledger.promise: Inventory build will normalise by March
ledger.delivered: Working-capital days went the other way: 58 → 71
CWIP up to ₹1,980 cr from ₹1,100 cr; on track at H1
Still 71 days a quarter later; target now restated for year-end

analysis.guidance_drift: Growth aspiration raised (above 1.5× industry); margin band held at 11–13% despite running above it; working-capital normalisation date pushed out twice.

narrative.claim: Margins are structurally higher because of mix and scale

narrative.numbers: No segment disclosure yet to test it; exports were called soft in Q4 FY26

narrative.claim: Demand from transmission and data centres is strong
narrative.numbers: Five straight quarters of 17%+ YoY revenue growth

business.what: India's largest wires & cables maker, adding consumer electricals (fans, lights, switchgear) and an EPC arm.

bull.point: Revenue compounding 26.2% a year (3y) with margins holding — scale, not price, is driving it
FMEG crossed breakeven on schedule: management delivered the hard promise
Near debt-free (D/E 0.05) while funding ₹1,600 cr+ capex

bear.point: Profit isn't turning into cash: CFO/PAT 0.71× in FY26
Working-capital fix has been 'next quarter' for three calls
Paying 45.6× earnings for a margin running above management's own sustainable band

watch: Working-capital days at Q3 FY27 (claimed path back to ≈ 60)
